items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GAME: Stardew Valley. STATE: Fri 12 Spring Yr1, 8:30pm, 218g, raining, dark. Farmer in clearing on farm with rocks, stumps, dense vegetation. NPC in purple/blue clothing at right edge ~(0.95,0.35).

CONTROLS CONFIRMED: WASD move (0.1-2s). Diagonal combos work (S+D, W+D tested). X=interact adjacent tile (must face target). Left-click=NOT pathfinding—causes time jump and camera pan. 1-9 toolbar select. M=map, Escape closes. C=use selected tool (causes time to pass). Wait≈10 game-min per 3s real-time.

INVENTORY: Slot 1-2: axes. Slot 3: watering can. Slot 4: pickaxe (currently selected). Slot 5: scythe+Fiber x68. Slot 6: chest. Slot 7: wall decoration. Slot 9: parsnip seeds x15. NO HOE—cannot till/plant.

FRI 12 NAVIGATION FAILURE: Woke 7:20am, moved east to mailbox but couldn't read it. Descended porch steps 8:50am, followed dirt path south/east. 9:10am at eastern farm edge. Attempted to reach farm exit but became trapped in pond clearing (large pond, rocks, stumps, trees). Spent 9:10am-8:30pm (11+ hours) attempting to navigate out. Multiple directions tried: S, D, A, W, diagonals (S+D, W+D). Movement extremely slow or blocked by terrain—often no visible progress after 2s movement. Pickaxe swings at 2:50pm-3:00pm (2× facing east) failed to break rocks—either out of range or rocks require direct adjacency. Map opened 3×: showed farmer in upper-left/west farm area, farmhouse to east/southeast, exit road runs SOUTH from farmhouse to bottom boundary then east. Clicked screen at 3:40pm (0.6,0.3)—caused 20min time jump, no pathfinding. Pierre's 5pm closing passed—town trip failed for 5th consecutive day.

TERRAIN OBSERVATIONS: Pond clearing filled with: large pond (blue water), multiple gray rocks, tree stumps (brown cylindrical), tall trees, dense vegetation. Keyboard navigation nearly impossible in cluttered areas—movement blocked by invisible collision or obstacles. Weeds (dark leafy tiles) block movement. Dirt paths exist but hard to stay on. Map shows farmhouse has clear dirt road running south to exit, but reaching that road from western clearing extremely difficult.

NPC SIGHTING: 8:10pm NPC in purple/blue clothing standing at right edge of clearing ~(0.95,0.35). Not yet met. Introductions quest: 1/28 (only Lewis met Tue 9). Small brown creature (squirrel?) appeared briefly 4:00pm after screen click.

FAILED OBJECTIVES: Mon 8: Pierre's (trapped indoors 14.5h). Tue 9: Pierre's (entrance not found despite 5h search). Wed 10: unknown (collapsed 2am, 26g penalty). Thu 11: Pierre's 9am arrival (navigation too slow, collapsed 2am, 24g penalty). Fri 12: mailbox reading (out of reach), Pierre's visit (stuck in clearing 11+ hours, couldn't reach exit).

FARM GEOGRAPHY: Farmhouse center-left of farm (brown building on map). Mailbox at ~(0.70,0.37) with envelope icon (unread mail—likely Egg Festival notice for Sat 13). Porch has railing barrier; steps at southeast corner ~(0.62,0.57) descend to ground. Dirt path runs east from house past mailbox. Western farm area has large pond clearing surrounded by dense obstacles. Exit road (observed on map): runs SOUTH from farmhouse area to bottom boundary, then east along bottom to main road leading north to town.

TOWN ROUTE (Tue 9): Farm exit→signpost→fenced road→cobblestone→lamp junction→stone stairs→winding path→fork→plaza. Keyboard travel time: 1+ hours (6:10am departure, 1:10pm arrival). Plaza: red-brick fountain center, clinic NE (white building, green cross), Saloon east (brown, orange sign). Pierre's entrance NEVER VISUALLY IDENTIFIED despite 5+ hour Tue 9 search.

QUESTS: 'To The Beach' (visit before 5pm for Willy's gift—failed Fri 5). 'Introductions' (1/28: Lewis only).

COLLAPSE MECHANIC: 2am collapse = teleport to porch/safe location + gold penalty (26g Wed 10→Thu 11, 24g Thu 11→Fri 12). Currently 8:30pm—5h30min until collapse.

UNRESOLVED: Pierre's location/entrance in town. Pierre's hours (hypothesis: 9am-5pm UNCONFIRMED). How to navigate farm terrain efficiently—keyboard movement fails in cluttered areas. Whether hoe exists elsewhere for planting seeds. Why eastern dirt path didn't lead to exit (may have veered into western clearing). Whether tools can clear weeds/rocks (pickaxe failed at distance; may need direct adjacency). NPC at right edge identity. Mailbox reading method. Unread mail content.
